title: First Positive Copier Completion
statement: For every Boolean input word $x$, every valid input-head position $p$, source word $w$, and record $r$, there exists a natural number $t$ with $0<t\le 3|w|+3$ such that, for every natural number $j<t$, the copier is not in its completed control after $j$ steps from the specified initial configuration. After $t$ steps it is in the completed control, with source word $w$, record $r$ extended by the self-delimiting encoding of $w$, source head at zero, record head at the new record length, input-head position $p$, and empty output.
replaced: For every input word, input position, source word $w$, and record, there is a time $t$ with $0 < t \le 3|w| + 3$ such that the copier is never in the completed control before $t$, and at $t$ it holds the record extended by the self-delimiting encoding of $w$, with the source untouched and both heads as specified; a host can therefore dispatch on completion without knowing the field length.
